summary: The page displays minor-to-major layout and alignment defects under RTL, including centered text alignment in input fields and cramped media clip metadata.

issues.title: Centered text in single-line inputs
issues.description: Input values in single-line text fields are centered instead of adhering to standard text direction alignment.
issues.evidence: The 'إلى' and 'نسخة إلى' fields display centered text strings rather than start-aligned text.
issues.suggestion: Set text alignment to start/right for RTL input fields.

issues.title: Cramped metadata and badge clipping in attachments
issues.description: Attachment clip headers have tight vertical margins against waveforms, and adjacent preview elements suffer from clipping.
issues.evidence: The first audio clip title overlaps closely with the waveform, and the third attachment pill truncates text prematurely.
issues.suggestion: Increase vertical spacing between clip metadata and waveform tracks, and allow adequate width for attachment labels.
